description: This file implements the ConnectionController class and related observer classes for managing WebRTC peer connections, signaling, and ICE candidate handling within the cuttlefish project. It includes methods for creating offers, handling signaling messages, and managing connection state changes.

classes.name: CreateSessionDescriptionObserverIntermediate
classes.description: Intermediate observer class for handling success and failure callbacks of creating session descriptions.

classes.name: SetSessionDescriptionObserverIntermediate
classes.description: Intermediate observer class for handling success and failure callbacks of setting local session descriptions.

classes.name: SetRemoteDescriptionObserverIntermediate
classes.description: Intermediate observer class for handling completion callback of setting remote session descriptions.

classes.name: ConnectionController
classes.description: Main class managing WebRTC peer connection lifecycle, signaling, and ICE candidates within the cuttlefish project.

methods.name: CreateOffer
methods.description: Initiates creation of an SDP offer for the peer connection.

methods.name: RequestOffer
methods.description: Sends a request to the peer to initiate an offer, optionally including ICE servers.

methods.name: FailConnection
methods.description: Handles connection failure by sending an error message and notifying observers.

methods.name: AddPendingIceCandidates
methods.description: Adds ICE candidates that arrived before the remote description was set.

methods.name: OnOfferRequestMsg
methods.description: Handles an incoming offer request message, creating a peer connection and initiating an offer.

methods.name: OnOfferMsg
methods.description: Handles an incoming SDP offer message and sets it as the remote description.

methods.name: OnAnswerMsg
methods.description: Handles an incoming SDP answer message and sets it as the remote description.

methods.name: OnIceCandidateMsg
methods.description: Handles an incoming ICE candidate message and adds it to the peer connection or stores it for later.

methods.name: OnErrorMsg
methods.description: Logs an error message received from the peer.

methods.name: OnCreateSDPSuccess
methods.description: Handles successful creation of an SDP, setting it as local description and sending it via signaling.

methods.name: OnCreateSDPFailure
methods.description: Handles failure in creating an SDP.

methods.name: OnSetLocalDescriptionSuccess
methods.description: Callback for successful setting of local description.

methods.name: OnSetLocalDescriptionFailure
methods.description: Handles failure in setting local description.

methods.name: OnSetRemoteDescriptionComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of setting remote description, creating an answer if needed.

methods.name: HandleSignalingMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming signaling messages and dispatches to appropriate handlers.

methods.name: HandleSignalingMessageInner
methods.description: Internal method to parse and handle specific signaling message types.

methods.name: OnSignalingChange
methods.description: Logs signaling state changes.

methods.name: OnAddStream
methods.description: Logs when a new media stream is added.

methods.name: OnRemoveStream
methods.description: Logs when a media stream is removed.

methods.name: OnDataChannel
methods.description: Handles remote data channel events.

methods.name: OnRenegotiationNeeded
methods.description: Triggers renegotiation by creating a new offer.

methods.name: OnStandardizedIceConnectionChange
methods.description: Logs changes in ICE connection state.

methods.name: OnConnectionChange
methods.description: Notifies observer of connection state changes.

methods.name: OnIceGatheringChange
methods.description: Logs changes in ICE gathering state.

methods.name: OnIceCandidate
methods.description: Sends gathered ICE candidates via signaling.

methods.name: OnIceCandidateError
methods.description: Logs ICE candidate gathering errors.

methods.name: OnIceCandidatesRemoved
methods.description: Handles removal of ICE candidates (no-op).

methods.name: OnTrack
methods.description: Handles remote media track events.

methods.name: OnRemoveTrack
methods.description: Handles remote track removal events.

methods.name: ThisAsCreateSDPObserver
methods.description: Creates an observer for SDP creation callbacks.

methods.name: ThisAsSetSDPObserver
methods.description: Creates an observer for setting local SDP callbacks.

methods.name: ThisAsSetRemoteSDPObserver
methods.description: Creates an observer for setting remote SDP callbacks.
